meta.title: One bid: award all 10 units to Vendor A; approver rejects
gaps: Sign in as the approver and reject the submitted proposal with a remark.
Verify that no purchase order is created after rejection.
Return as the buyer and verify that awarding can be started again from Master QCS.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the approver and reject the submitted proposal with a remark.; Verify that no purchase order is created after rejection.; Return as the buyer and verify that awarding can be started again from Master QCS.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Verify the single real vendor column for Vendor A.
Verify Vendor A's bid quantity is 10 units.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate is 100 per unit.
Verify the displayed bid amount is 1,000.
Verify the Master QCS arithmetic for quantity, rate, line amount, and total.
Open the awarding screen for the closed bid.
Allocate the full line to Vendor A.
Verify all line items are selected and exactly one of one vendors is awarded.

args.goal: on the awarding screen, click Create Proposal, fill all required proposal fields, submit the proposal, and stop on the submitted proposal page

steps.note: Complete the proposal fields and submission, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the submitted proposal page opened.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, reject it with a remark, then return as the buyer and verify that no PO was created and awarding can be started again from Master QCS

steps.note: The separate approver session, rejection, PO absence, and post-rejection re-awarding check require another user and are not available to catalog steps.
Assert that the proposal page shows the rejection outcome after the approver action.
